category: Make a Music Video from a Song

features.name: Upload a track + lyrics
features.description: Drop in an audio file and paste the lyrics; M2V handles the rest. One audio file plus the words is all that's needed to start a render.
features.notes: POST /api/generate accepts the audio upload + lyrics form field; service launches and accepts jobs, end-to-end render lightly tested

features.name: Auto-extract lyrics from the audio
features.description: Don't have the lyrics typed out? M2V can read them straight from the song — first from embedded tags, then by listening to the track and transcribing it.
features.notes: /api/extract-lyrics: ID3 USLT/SYLT tags first, then OpenAI Whisper transcription; built, light verification

features.name: Pick a visual style
features.description: Choose how the video looks — cinematic, anime, watercolour, cyberpunk, fantasy, documentary, abstract, or vintage. The chosen style flavours every generated scene.
features.notes: 8 styles in STYLE_MODIFIERS (engine/lyric_analyzer.py) wired through the UI dropdown

features.name: Keep the same faces across scenes
features.description: Upload a reference photo of the person(s) in the video and M2V keeps their appearance consistent from scene to scene, so it feels like one cast rather than ten strangers.
features.notes: Optional reference image + IP-Adapter on SDXL; strength slider (ip_scale, default 0.6); code complete, needs GPU weights

features.name: Lyrics burned in as subtitles
features.description: The song's words appear on screen, timed to each section, so the video is captioned out of the box. Can be toggled off.
features.notes: SRT generated from scene timings + FFmpeg subtitles filter; 'Burn subtitles' checkbox; real .srt files produced in data/output

features.name: Download the finished MP4
features.description: When the render is done you get a single, audio-synced MP4 ready to share.
features.notes: GET /api/download/{job_id} returns a video/mp4 FileResponse; 3 sample outputs exist in data/output

features.name: Runs entirely on local hardware
features.description: Every step — scene writing, image generation, animation, assembly — happens on the owner's own GPU. The song never leaves the machine and there is no per-render cloud bill.
features.notes: Ollama (local LLM) + SDXL/SVD via diffusers on the local RTX 5080; no external generation API

features.name: No subscription or API cost
features.description: Built on open models (Stable Diffusion XL, Stable Video Diffusion, Whisper) so generating a video costs nothing but electricity and time.
features.notes: All models are open-weight; only cost is local compute

features.name: Live progress log
features.description: While a video renders you see each stage as it happens — analysing lyrics, segmenting audio, generating clip 3 of 10, assembling — rather than staring at a blank bar.
features.notes: Pipeline yields per-stage event dicts; UI polls /api/status/{id}/events and updates a Gradio progress bar + log box

features.name: Graceful fallbacks
features.description: If the local AI director is offline, M2V still produces simple prompts; if a scene's image is missing, it inserts a labelled placeholder and keeps going rather than failing the whole video.
features.notes: Ollama-unavailable -> _fallback_prompt; missing frame -> placeholder clip (proven in make_forro_video.py); librosa-unavailable -> even time split

features.name: First real music video rendered
features.description: A complete 160-second anime music video ('Churrasco na Geórgia') was assembled from a real song, with timed Portuguese lyric captions and crossfades between ten scenes — proving the assembly path works.
features.notes: forro_anime_mv.mp4 (~3.9 MB) rendered in 706s via make_forro_video.py; scenes used placeholders (real frames pending ComfyUI run)

features.name: Registered in the QI ecosystem
features.description: M2V is listed in the QI registry with its ports, path, and family role, so the QI Hive dashboard and sibling projects know it exists.

features.name: Standard health/identity endpoints
features.description: Exposes the QI module contract endpoints any QI project can call to check it is alive and learn what it does.

features.name: Always-on service + public URL
features.description: Can run 24/7 as a Windows service and be reachable at a permanent public web address.
features.notes: install_service.bat (QI_M2V) + named Cloudflare tunnel qi-m2v -> m2v.quiddityinnovations.com; installers present, not yet in QI_Service_Registry.md

features.name: Feeds from sibling creative tools
features.description: Designed to take audio generated by PersonalSong and turn it into a video, with AvatarStudio as a video-side sibling.
features.notes: No integration wired yet; integrates_with is empty in the registry
